newsitem.title: USA: Panda Project strikes distribution deal.
newsitem.headline: Panda Project strikes distribution deal.

text.p: Panda Project Inc said Thursday it signed a letter of intent with Inno Micro Corp of Yokohama, Japan, to distribute and sell Panda Project's products and to represent the company in that country.

The distribution arrangement, which is subject to negotiation of a definitive agreement, provides that Inno Micro will introduce Panda's high-density VSPA semiconductor package and Compass Connector to Japanese electronics manufacturers.

The Japanese semiconductor package market is currently estimated at about $12 billion, or about 40 percent of the worldwide market, while the Japanese connector market, which is currently worth an estimated $6 billion, makes up about 20 percent of the world's total market, Panda said.
